subject.title: Surface Codex final answer candidates in activity

question: Should this conflicting PR be rebased and landed as a narrow answer-candidate Activity slice, or folded into the broader native Codex progress work tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80039?
rationale: The submitted behavior is useful and proven, but current main moved the Activity architecture and the remaining choice is the permanent Control UI product surface, not a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Rebase the narrow slice
options.body: Retarget the PR to ui/src/pages/activity and keep answer-candidate lifecycle entries as a bounded Activity feature while preserving current redaction/session filtering.

options.title: Fold into broader progress work
options.body: Close or pause this PR and handle answer candidates together with the full native Codex progress UX in the canonical issue.

options.title: Pause until UX is settled
options.body: Leave the branch unmerged until maintainers decide whether Activity is the right surface for this lifecycle.

recommendation.title: Rebase the narrow slice
recommendation.body: Retarget the PR to ui/src/pages/activity and keep answer-candidate lifecycle entries as a bounded Activity feature while preserving current redaction/session filtering.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current Activity module layout and recent adjacent Control UI/Codex work that determines the rebase target.
